mentions.name: Todo or else
mentions.description: A Go CLI called "todo or else" that scans projects for TODO comments and checks they have deadlines, holding you accountable for completing them. It can also verify other things such as whether TODOs have owners. Built on Tree Sitter so it can handle most programming languages (shipping with a subset of grammars), with a cross-platform release planned in a couple of weeks.
